evidence.claim: FastVolt commissioned a 360 kW pilot charger at Afriquia Al Boustane near Bouznika, described as four DC plus two AC outputs capable of simultaneous use.
Independent Moroccan automotive press also reports FastVolt operating a 360 kW charger at Afriquia Al Boustane.
Current public listing identifies the site as FastVolt but reports 100 kW maximum and 8 charging points with Type 2 and CCS.

classification.production_recommendation: Keep the station and CPO attribution, but do not overwrite connector-level power/count from the FastVolt public API solely with either third-party value. Prefer native FastVolt app/API evidence if recovered; until then retain the existing native/public FastVolt inventory values and flag this site for manual app verification.
